verdicts.reason: A and B look identical at this size. In both, the wind-turbine icon, which is the hero image in the original, shrinks to a tiny smudge at the far left, jammed against the left edge and the headline, and loses its cyan circle. The red, green and blue triangles are cut down to unreadable slivers at the edges, and the headline/date block sits slightly left of centre with dead space to the right, so the banner reads as a shrunk copy rather than a left-to-right layout.
